claims: The final round of the 2026 Masters is on April 12.
CBS Sports provides TV coverage from 2:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET.
Paramount+ provides early coverage from 12:00 p.m. to 2:00 p.m. ET.
Paramount+ provides the main CBS broadcast from 2:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET.
Masters.com and the Masters App provide featured groups coverage from 9:20 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET.
Masters.com and the Masters App provide Amen Corner coverage from 11:15 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET.
Masters.com and the Masters App provide holes 15 & 16 coverage from 12:05 p.m. to 6:30 p.m. ET.
Featured holes coverage is available on the ESPN App, Amazon Prime Video, and DirecTV.
The Green Jacket Ceremony takes place on Masters.com at 7 p.m. ET.
Free streaming of Amen Corner and featured groups is available on Masters.com and the Masters App starting at 9:20 a.m. ET
